title: Test-set registry (contract 6.12, schema_version 0.1)
description: config/test_set.json (Stage 6.1, S6-1, D26): the scoring (test) data that must never feed the rule library. match_ids: the audited AI-Red golden matches. sealed: the offline benign files sealed before the first train match (D27), with their sha256 once captured (null = not sealed yet: tools/promote_rules.py refuses until every entry is sealed). tools/promote_rules.py refuses any listed match and checks each sealed file exists, with that hash, at the train match's recorded commit. test_purposes (Stage 6.3, D35, optional): match purposes that are TEST data by construction (eval), so a match is registered as test data from the moment it exists; tools/promote_rules.py refuses them.
